name: Etched Parchment
summary: Etched Parchment is an initiation quest directing young orc hunters in the Valley of Trials to their local class trainer, Jen'shan. Delivered through Gornek after an initiate's first blooding, the note opens the door to specialized wilderness training and survival skills in Durotar.

sections.title: A Summons from the Wild
sections.body: After proving their basic mettle against the local mottled boars, hunters starting in the Valley of Trials receive an etched parchment handled by Gornek. The missive originates from Jen'shan, a skilled Darkspear hunter who observes new arrivals from the edges of the encampment. The note serves as an official invitation to begin formal training, acknowledging that the initiate possesses the instincts required to master the untamed beasts and harsh landscape of Durotar.

sections.title: The Hunter's Way
sections.body: Reporting to Jen'shan marks the transition from common recruit to dedicated stalker. Jen'shan disabuses newcomers of the notion that the hunter's craft is simpler than the arcane arts or ancestral shamanism. Mastering Durotar's predators, maintaining ranged weaponry, and surviving off an unforgiving land demand relentless discipline. She directs her apprentices to aid the other denizens of the valley to test their abilities before returning to her for more advanced survival techniques.

faq.answer: It is a written summons delivered by Gornek on behalf of the hunter trainer Jen'shan. It calls promising recruits to report to her for specialized martial and wilderness instruction in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Who delivers this summons to the player?
aliases: where do i get the quest
faq.answer: Gornek hands over the parchment after you complete your initial trial of slaying mottled boars in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan is a Darkspear troll hunter stationed in the Valley of Trials. She evaluates new orc and troll hunters, teaching them the foundational skills of ranged warfare, tracking, and beastcraft.

faq.q: Why does Jen'shan compare hunters to mages and shamans?
faq.answer: Jen'shan warns that many dismiss hunting as an easy path compared to wielding ancestral spirits or arcane magic. She emphasizes that mastering lethal marksmanship and wild beasts requires equal dedication and danger.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Jen'shan?
faq.answer: Jen'shan introduces you to advanced hunter techniques and instructs you to aid the other inhabitants of the Valley of Trials to hone your newly acquired skills in practical survival.
This quest is exclusively offered to newly created orc hunters training in the Valley of Trials.

angles.text: This note represents your first formal recognition as a hunter of the Horde, pointing you to Jen'shan to refine your aim and understand the wild.
For Darkspear recruits, studying under Jen'shan keeps alive the ancient jungle tracking traditions carried over from the Echo Isles.
Orcish hunters rely on mentors like Jen'shan to adapt traditional clan hunting methods to the arid crags and deadly beasts of Durotar.
Hunters scout the borders and feed the camps; introducing initiates to their craft early ensures the nascent nation of Durotar stays supplied and guarded.
